That shell call was malformed and nothing ran. I'll write the new `ranges.py` directly.

The full range syntax is implemented, but one existing unit test fails. `tests/test_ranges.py` `CaretTest.test_zero_major` expects `^0.2.3` to stop before `0.3.0`, while `docs/ranges.md` requires it to end before `1.0.0`.

The other 41 tests pass (`python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`). The failing one contradicts the spec, and `docs/changelog.md` also says "stops before `0.3.0`". I followed `ranges.md`. It says in three places that a caret ends at the next major release for 0.x too, citing range review PRV-7731. If the changelog and test are right, the fix is to change the caret upper bound in `_comparator` in `pinset/ranges.py`. I didn't touch the tests.

I also ran spec examples through `parse_range` by hand, including the error cases, and they matched. A `check` over `data/` and a `resolve --dev` over every manifest ran without crashing.

- **Ranges:** `pinset/ranges.py` is rewritten. It reads caret, tilde, wildcards, hyphen ranges, comparator sets and `||`, with the `bad-range` and `bad-version` split and the prerelease and exact-range rules from the spec.
- **Version precedence:** `pinset/version.py` compared prerelease identifiers as plain strings, so `beta.2 < beta.11` came out wrong. Numeric identifiers now compare numerically and sort below alphanumeric ones. I also removed Python's limit on the number of digits in a version number.
- **`outdated`:** `pinset/commands/outdated.py` now reports a range's error code even when the package has no newest non-yanked, non-prerelease release.
- **`why`:** `pinset/resolver.py` could stop `chain` early when a release's label equalled the manifest's label. It now records which packages were chosen for the manifest's own requirements.

`/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `partial`, because of the failing test.

cd /app; cat docs/index.md docs/manifest.md docs/resolve.md docs/output.md
cd /app; cat pinset/*.py pinset/commands/*.py; cat tests/test_ranges.py tests/support.py; git log --oneline | head

cd /app; cat pinset/version.py pinset/ranges.py pinset/names.py pinset/resolver.py pinset/output.py pinset/commands/__init__.py pinset/commands/check.py pinset/commands/match.py pinset/commands/outdated.py pinset/commands/resolve.py; sed -n 30,70p pinset/manifest.py
cd /app; for f in pinset/version.py pinset/ranges.py pinset/names.py pinset/resolver.py pinset/output.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done

cd /app; for f in pinset/commands/__init__.py pinset/commands/check.py pinset/commands/match.py pinset/commands/outdated.py pinset/commands/resolve.py; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; sed -n 28,70p pinset/manifest.py

cd /app; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30; grep -n text tests/*.py | head -20; python -m pinset resolve data/manifests/project-000.toml --format text; ls ~ /app; python --version
cd /app; ls -la pinset/ranges.py; touch pinset/ranges.py && echo ok; df -h /app | tail -1

cd /app; python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='pinset/resolver.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''        self.chosen = {}  # name -> (Release, by)
''','''        self.chosen = {}  # name -> (Release, by)
        self.direct = set()  # names chosen for a requirement of the manifest
''')
s=s.replace('''queue = deque((name, text, manifest.label) for name, text in manifest.requirements(dev))''','''queue = deque((name, text, manifest.label, True) for name, text in manifest.requirements(dev))''')
s=s.replace('''        name, text, by = queue.popleft()''','''        name, text, by, direct = queue.popleft()''')
s=s.replace('''        res.chosen[name] = (release, by)
        queue.extend((dep, dep_range, release.label) for''','''        res.chosen[name] = (release, by)
        if direct:
            res.direct.add(name)
        queue.extend((dep, dep_range, release.label, False) for''')
s=s.replace('''        if by == res.root:
            break''','''        if name in res.direct:
            break''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n direct pinset/resolver.py

cd /app; python -m pinset check | tail -5; echo rc=$?; for m in data/manifests/*.toml; do python -m pinset resolve $m --dev >/tmp/o.json 2>/tmp/e.txt; echo "$m $? $(grep -c code /tmp/o.json) $(wc -c </tmp/e.txt)"; done | awk '{print $2,$4}' | sort | uniq -c; python -m pinset outdated data/manifests/project-014.toml --dev; python -m pinset match arbel-io '^1' ; echo rc=$?
